_template_only_note: This file is schema guidance only and must not be copied as an artifact in production. Use ib_research_graph.py compile to generate real entries from research_graph_state.json.
purpose: Archive reviewable snapshots for formal usable evidence sources. Research-context sources keep URL/title/summary and do not require audit-grade snapshots. Broad discovery leads do not require archive entries.
field_alias_note: Use canonical entries[]. Validators tolerate archive_entries/snapshot_type/snapshot_path aliases to reduce repair loops, but new artifacts should use entries/archive_status/archive_path.

entries.locator: page/section/table/paragraph used for later Knowledge/QC review
entries.reviewed_excerpt: Short reviewed excerpt or paraphrased locator context used to support the EV row.

status_values.saved_html: Full HTML source was downloaded with explicit capture_method=full_page_capture or archived_copy_reviewed and a reviewable snapshot was saved at archive_path.
status_values.saved_text: Full text/markdown source capture saved at archive_path with explicit capture_method. Long excerpts or snippets alone are not saved_text.
status_values.saved_pdf: PDF source saved at archive_path with explicit capture_method=downloaded_pdf or user_provided_file.
status_values.manual_verified_excerpt: Full download failed, but Research completed secondary verification, explicitly declared research_archive_status=manual_verified_excerpt, verification_method, and saved a source-faithful excerpt with locator and verification notes.
status_values.needs_research_verification: Full download failed and Research has not yet completed secondary verification. Keep as a lead/gap, not evidence.
status_values.search_snippet_only: Only a search-result snippet is available. Keep as a lead only.
status_values.excerpt_snapshot: Legacy ambiguous status. Rebuild as manual_verified_excerpt or needs_research_verification.
status_values.archive_unavailable: No file could be saved; reviewed_excerpt and archive_unavailable_reason must explain the limitation.
status_values.research_context: ODR-style background source retained with URL/title/summary only. It is not evidence-ready and cannot support key numbers, charts, or hard claims.
status_values.user_provided: Source is user-provided/management material and is governed by the user file, not web archive.
